description: Screen up to 25 organization names (500 with a Seraphix API key) against OFAC SDN, SAM.gov exclusions, HHS-OIG LEIE and FARA registrants. Returns a status per row (id_match, name_match_unconfirmed, clear, skipped_person, skipped_blank), the hits with match type and source link, and each list's date. A name match is unconfirmed until an ID (UEI, CAGE, EIN, NPI) is checked. Inputs are not stored.
name: screen_organizations
title: Screen organizations against U.S. sanctions and exclusion lists
